rationale: C19 is a highly plausible drafting template. It addresses the same bituminous-coal industry, coal operators, and United Mine Workers; uses nearly the same national-emergency findings; and contains the same Title II powers, section 206 reporting requirement, and continuation-until-termination provisions in the same sequence. C13 is another very close coal-specific predecessor, while C12 shares the same statutory structure but applies it to meat packing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a labor dispute between certain bituminous coal operators and associations and certain of their employees represented by the International Union, United Mine Workers of America, involving wages and terms and conditions of employment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a labor dispute ... between coal operators and associations ... and certain of their employees represented by the International Union, United Mine Workers of America ... involving wages and terms and conditions of employment
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive coal-specific party identification and subject matter are reused with only limited updating.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such dispute has resulted or threatens to result in a strike or lockout affecting a substantial part of the bituminous coal industry ... which strike or lockout, if permitted to occur or to continue, will imperil the national health and safety
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such dispute threatens to result in a strike or lockout affecting a substantial part of the bituminous coal industry ... which strike or lockout, if permitted to occur or to continue, will imperil the national health and safety
shared_material.explanation: The core factual and legal finding is nearly verbatim, including the unusually specific occur-or-continue formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of the said Act. The Board shall report to the President in accordance with provisions of section 206 of the said Act
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of the said Act. The Board shall report to the President in accordance with provisions of section 206 of the said Act
shared_material.explanation: The operative legal machinery is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Upon submission of its report, the Board shall continue in existence to perform such other functions as may be required under the said Act, until the Board is terminated by the President.
